units.summary: Adds errorCacheTTL (5 minutes) controlling how long failed lookups are remembered. The comment justifies it with permanently forbidden records, but the cache applies to all errors.
units.headline: Adds 5-minute errorCacheTTL variable for failed lookups
units.reason: Constant only; behavior is determined in GetRecord, which is reviewed there.

units.summary: New struct pairing an error with an expiry time, used for negative caching.
units.headline: New cachedError type holding error and expiry
units.reason: Plain data type, only used by GetRecord.

units.summary: Client gains an errors map plus overridable get and now function fields. The maps are unsynchronized, as before for the cache.
units.headline: Client gets error cache map and injectable get/now hooks
units.reason: Struct is unexported-use internal; fields only used by the Client methods.

units.summary: Constructor initializes the error map and clock, and wires get to fetchFromServer.
units.headline: NewClient initializes error cache and hook defaults
units.reason: Straightforward initialization supporting the new fields.

units.summary: GetRecord drops the retry param and now caches every failed lookup for 5 minutes, returning the cached error until expiry. Retry logic moved to fetchFromServer.

issues.title: Transient errors are negatively cached for 5 minutes
issues.detail: All errors are cached, not only server error replies. A connect failure or context timeout (1s requestTimeout) makes the key unavailable for 5 minutes even after the server recovers. Since loadMetadata now ignores the error, the item silently loses owner/system info for that period.
issues.failure_scenario: Inventory is briefly down or slow; the lookup for key 'orders' fails with a dial error or deadline exceeded. After the server recovers, calls for 5 minutes still return the cached error and the record is treated as having no owner.

units.headline: GetRecord negatively caches all failures for five minutes
units.reason: Changes error handling, caching and public signature; affects what callers see after outages.
focus: Whether transient errors (dial failure, timeout) should be cached or only ReplyError
Concurrent callers on the unguarded cache and errors maps
Callers that relied on the removed retry parameter

units.summary: Moves connect/get/retry into a loop: on a non-reply error it closes the connection and retries once, but returns immediately for server error replies.
units.headline: Extracted fetch loop; skips reconnect on server error replies
units.reason: Retry and connection-handling logic changed.
focus: Retry happens once (attempt>0 exit) and a failed connect on the second attempt returns the error
Context cancellation errors still trigger a reconnect on the first attempt

units.summary: Helper that detects a ReplyError via errors.As. ReplyError has a value receiver, so the value target matches.
units.headline: Adds helper detecting server ReplyError via errors.As
units.reason: Small pure helper, covered by tests; used only to skip reconnects.

units.summary: Call site updated for the dropped retry argument.
units.headline: Call updated to new GetRecord signature
units.reason: Only removes the now-nonexistent argument; retry=true behavior now lives in fetchFromServer.
